about: The Workbench icons of the Rafkill drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/rafkill.png) is the player's first hull, HULL_1_1 from the game's own data/raptor.dat, scaled to 128 x 128, LGPL-2 or later like the game. Rafkill-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Rafkill.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Rafkill, COPYING.txt, Controls and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
